address: 4217 Field Oak DR, Wake Forest, NC 27587
description: This former Parade of Homes beauty won't last long, beautifully situated on a premium, private 0.43-acre corner lot in Wake Forest — rated the #1 most in-demand suburb in the US by MoveBuddha in early 2026. The upgraded kitchen features a brand-new dishwasher and gas stove, quartz countertops, and a barstool island, alongside newly refinished hardwoods throughout. A media/bonus room (with projector and screen included) can double as a 5th bedroom, and the huge fenced backyard includes a screened porch for outdoor entertaining. An unfinished, insulated third floor offers room to expand, and the side-entry garage includes a workshop with a sink. The neighborhood offers resident swim, golf, tennis, and fitness memberships, including two pools with a lazy river and water slide, plus an award-winning semi-private 18-hole golf course.
